summary: Round 2 (multi-tenant SaaS) tested end to end. Backend: a new 16-case suite (tests/test_round2_multitenant.py) passes 100%, and the old 18-case regression suite also passes. Covered: signup with trial, seeded ledgers and FY; duplicate signup and validation; cross-tenant isolation for ledgers, vouchers, reports, users, audit, settings, FY and backup; trial user limit of 2 (plus reactivation blocked); expired business gets 402 on writes and reads still work; plan totals 7670 and 11800 with payments_enabled=false and order 503; platform 403 for normal users; extend plan and issue key; licence activate up to 2 devices then 400, validate with alert, deactivate frees a slot, revoke makes the key invalid, key lookup is case-insensitive; GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B (Gupta Oct-2026 gives exactly cgst 32.5 and sgst 112.5 cash, plus a hand-built B2B/B2C/CN/purchase/DN case); UPI validation; logo upload type and size checks with byte-exact retrieval; logo isolated per business. Frontend: signup page and link from login, amber trial banner, red expired banner with New Voucher and quick actions hidden, /voucher/sales redirects to /subscription, Subscription page notice and disabled pay buttons, licence table, activation tester and device deactivate, Platform extend with a key toast, Branding logo upload and preview, UPI/bank fields saved, branded TAX INVOICE popup (logo, both GSTINs, HSN, CGST/SGST, amount in words, bank details, UPI QR), GSTR-1/3B tabs with month picker, admin TB/BS balanced. Found 1 high bug (restore not atomic), 1 medium UI bug (/platform for non-superadmin crashes with an overlay) and several minor ones.

critical.issue: Restore is not atomic, and it fails with 500 when the backup has ids already in the DB (for example, restoring business Y's backup into business X). It runs delete_many and then insert_many one collection at a time. The unique index on financial_years.id raises BulkWriteError after settings and financial_years were already deleted. Reproduced: X was left with 0 financial years, so the frontend stays on 'Loading...' forever, and X's settings were replaced by a doc carrying Y's settings id. Fix: validate first, give each restored doc a new id (or map ids), wrap the restore in try/except and roll back from restore_snapshots on failure, and return 400 instead of 500.

minor.issue: These use ADMIN, not ADMIN_WRITE, so an expired business can still write here. Verified: settings PUT and FY create return 200 for expired@test.in. Decide whether this is intended. At least FY create and users should probably return 402.
SettingsIn defaults every branding field to ''. An API client that sends only the company fields wipes upi_id, bank details and terms. The UI sends the full object, so the UI is not affected.
The GSTIN at signup is not checked against GSTIN_RE, while PUT /settings does check it. An invalid GSTIN can be stored.
Race: the device-count check and the $push are separate steps, so parallel activations can exceed max_devices. Use a conditional update_one with {'$expr': {'$lt': [{'$size': '$activations'}, max]}}.

The 'Docs' count for B2C in the summary counts aggregated rows (place of supply + rate), not invoices. One B2C invoice with 0% and 18% items shows Docs=2. B2C Large (inter-state over 2.5 lakh) is not split out.
Revoke writes no audit entry, and the Platform UI has no revoke button (API only).

ui_bugs.issue: A non-superadmin who opens /platform directly gets the page shell. api.get('/platform/businesses') then rejects with 403 without being caught, which shows an 'Unhandled rejection' error overlay that blocks clicks (logout could not be clicked). Guard the route with user.is_superadmin and add .catch to load().
Audit Trail is wrapped in <Protected write>. An expired admin still sees it in the sidebar, but it redirects to /subscription. Audit is read-only and should stay readable while books are read-only.

issues: At 1920px the last tab 'GSTR-3B' is cut off at the right edge of the horizontally scrolling tab bar. Wrap the tabs or split the GST tabs into their own group.
If activation fails (device limit), the result box clears and only a toast shows. Consider showing the error inline in licence-result.

action_items: Make POST /api/restore atomic and id-safe: no 500, and no data left half-deleted when ids collide or a backup from another business is restored
Guard /platform in the frontend for non-superadmins and catch the 403 in Platform.jsx load()
Decide on and enforce 402 for admin writes in expired businesses (settings, logo, users, FY)
Validate GSTIN at signup; make the licence activation device limit atomic; fix the GSTR-1 B2C doc count
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.restore: delete_many then insert_many per collection with no transaction or rollback. A restore_snapshot is saved but never used automatically on failure.
get_business raises 401 'Business not found'. On platform extend of an unknown id this returns 401, which can look like a logout to the frontend interceptor. 404 is better.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with Bearer auth works, but use explicit origins for production.
Auth is Bearer token in localStorage, not httpOnly cookies (the playbook checks for cookies). bcrypt hashes are $2b$. Lockout was verified in iteration 1.

success_rate.backend: 100% of the 34 pytest cases (16 new + 18 regression); 1 high bug found by an extra probe (restore)
success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; /platform crash for non-superadmin and /audit redirect for expired)

rca of the issue: Restore 500: routes_admin.restore loops over BACKUP_COLLECTIONS, runs delete_many for this business and then insert_many of the backup docs with their original 'id'. financial_years has a unique index on id, so if the docs' ids already exist anywhere (another business, or a stale duplicate in the backup), BulkWriteError is raised partway through. The earlier deletes are not rolled back, which leaves the business without an FY (the UI cannot load). Repro: signup X and Y; GET Y /api/backup; POST it to X /api/restore -> 500; X /api/financial-years -> []. Fix: regenerate ids (keeping internal references: ledger ids in vouchers, fy_id, counters), or pre-check collisions and return 400, and on any exception restore from the saved snapshot.
